data.name: Erkamoon
data.gender_notes: Erkamoon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who rules and leads like a lion. The name Erkamoon carries the meaning “Lion King” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Erkamoon usually hope their child will grow to embody lion king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and bravery, a fearless leader
data.etymology: Erkamoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erkamoon total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إركامون
in_arabic.meaning: إركامون هو اسم يعني التزام أو إلتزام ديني قوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: إركامون هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ك-م' والذي يعني التزام أو إلتزام ديني قوي. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحيان ليعبر عن الالتزام بالقيم الدينية والروحانية الإسلامية. يعتبر اسم إركامون من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة وروحانية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ارکمون
in_urdu.meaning: ارکمون کا مطلب ہے مضبوط عقیدہ یا دینی عہد
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارکمون ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ر-ک-م' جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط عقیدہ یا دینی عہد۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں روحانی اور دینی شدت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام دینی وابستگی اور روحانی سفر کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: एर्कामून
in_hindi.meaning: एर्कामून का अर्थ है मजबूत धार्मिक विश्वास या प्रतिज्ञा
in_hindi.long_meaning: एर्कामून एक अरबी नाम है जो 'र-क-म' जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत धार्मिक विश्वास या प्रतिज्ञा। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक दृढ़ता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम धार्मिक समर्पण और आध्यात्मिक यात्रा के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ارکامون
in_pashto.meaning: ارکامون د قوي مذهبي اعتقاد يا عهد معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارکامون د عربي نوم دی چی د 'ر-ک-م' جڑ څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې د قوي مذهبي اعتقاد يا عهد دی. دا نوم د اسلامي دودیزو کی د روحاني او مذهبي پابندی د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کی، دا نوم د مذهبي تړاو او روحاني سفر د نښه په توګه لیدل کیږي.

in_english.name: Erkamoon
in_english.meaning: Erkamoon means strong religious conviction or commitment
in_english.long_meaning: Erkamoon is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ك-م' (r-k-m), which signifies strong religious conviction or commitment. This name is used in Islamic tradition to symbolize spiritual and religious dedication. It reflects a deep sense of faith and adherence to Islamic values. Historically, names like Erkamoon were given to signify a family's or individual's strong religious identity and spiritual journey.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Erkamoon" signifies strength, courage, and leadership. In Islamic culture, lions are often associated with bravery and valor, making the name "Erkamoon" a powerful one that evokes images of fearless warriors and noble rulers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Erkamoon" can be seen as a reminder of one's inner strength and courage. It can serve as an inspiration to face challenges with confidence and to lead others with kindness and wisdom. Additionally, the lion is a symbol of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in Islamic tradition, so the name may also carry spiritual connotations related to his life and teachings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lion King" symbolizes The one who rules and leads like a lion. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Erkamoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lion king.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Erkamoon is mentioned in the 'History of the Prophets and Kings' by Ibn Abd al-Hakam as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad.
